page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Heading "DEDICATIO." at top, then the dedication paragraph, a centred address line, a small left-set date block, centred signature lines, and a signature at right. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.l: dundare possint. Ita Faxit Deus No-

page.notes: The date line is set in small type at left; the Roman numerals "clɔ IɔcLXXVI" are rendered as printed in the old reversed-C form, read as MDCLXXVI. The signature "Gerh: Von Mastricht D." is set in large capitals with an initial G. The dedication address line is partly damaged at the start of the first line ("& Academiæ"); the letter v in "vestrum" appears as a swash form and is read as v.
